findings.evidence: docs/modules/planned-items/domain-model.md Key Attributes table: '| amountCents | Integer | Non-negative integer, required; money stored in integer cents |' and docs/modules/plans/domain-model.md Item Key Attributes table: '| amountCents | int | Integer cents; the client computes this via a regex-validated parse ... |' both name the concrete data type used for amountCents (Integer/int) at the application layer.
findings.locationHint: [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] The supplied module-docs do not state whether the `Plan` entity or any other entity also stores a monetary total or amount as integer cents, nor do they name the concrete data type (e.g. integer column type) used to persist `amountCents` - the underlying Prisma schema was not among this node's inputs.
findings.message: This ADR claims no supplied doc names the concrete data type used for `amountCents`, but two other generated docs (docs/modules/planned-items/domain-model.md and docs/modules/plans/domain-model.md) both already state its type as Integer/int, contradicting the claim that the type is unnamed anywhere in the doc set.
